scope: Broad source discovery, not exhaustive and not plot verification or harvest counts.
estimate_warning: All eligible volumes are researcher estimates, not audited counts. Catalog access does not establish any individual ending; A means strongest available next research path, not that every item is verified.

collections.access_check: detailed synopsis sample opened; ending present
collections.limitations: Exclude straight science fiction/psychological-only stories; catalog is identification, individual episode pages supply endings.

collections.access_check: catalog opened; short descriptions, ending not sampled
collections.limitations: Separate segment from broadcast episode; comedic blackout fragments may have no plot.

collections.access_check: catalog opened; some spoiler descriptions, no systematic ending audit
collections.limitations: Some crime/no-supernatural episodes; locate fuller individual synopsis before marking complete.

collections.access_check: catalog opened; synopsis evidence varies
collections.limitations: Many human crime plots; supernatural eligibility requires screening.

collections.access_check: catalog opened; ending not sampled
collections.limitations: Separate paranormal creatures from science fiction; catalog blurbs may omit reveal.

collections.collection: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
collections.access_check: official catalog opened; premise blurbs only
collections.limitations: Official descriptions do not verify endings; original anthology tales and later serialized revival seasons require distinct units.

collections.access_check: episode catalog opened; ending not sampled
collections.limitations: Join Really You and other multipart tales; fan episode recaps need checking.

collections.access_check: catalog opened; episode descriptions
collections.limitations: Some recurring frame; brief catalog requires full recap for resolution.

collections.access_check: book/TV list opened; book ending evidence untested
collections.limitations: Do not mix TV adaptation and book plot; trilogy may need one completed arc.

collections.collection: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark trilogy
collections.access_check: collection identification opened; individual full text not checked
collections.limitations: Obtain book text or detailed reliable recap; traditional variants are distinct attributable retellings, not generic legend labels.

collections.access_check: publisher archive and full story sample opened
collections.limitations: Contemporary copyrighted fiction; very compact summaries only. Some literary/psychological horror lacks paranormal hook.

collections.access_check: publisher archive and full story sample opened
collections.limitations: Screen supernatural content and closure; some deliberate ambiguity remains a valid ending if accurately stated.

collections.access_check: publisher fiction catalog opened; story access not sampled
collections.limitations: Exclude science fiction and secondary-world stories without everyday setup; reprints duplicate other catalogs.

collections.access_check: search surfaced 54 horror stories; full-text sample returned
collections.limitations: Cross-check existing classics library to prevent duplicate works; availability/licensing varies by author.

collections.access_check: transcript index and full sample opened; unofficial mirror with some explicitly unofficial transcripts
collections.eligible_volume_estimate: 80–140 estimated bounded statement stories within 200-episode serial
collections.narrative_unit: completed statement narrative or completed serial arc
collections.limitations: A statement can finish while framing plot continues; record local payoff and unresolved mystery accurately. Never treat every installment as completed plot.

collections.access_check: official transcript index and finale-like A Solution transcript opened
collections.eligible_volume_estimate: 10–40 estimated completed compact arcs; not 295 independent plots
collections.narrative_unit: closed episode narrative or completed multi-episode arc
collections.limitations: Official index labels Locked Library Mystery across installments; identify beginning and resolution before harvesting. Latest episode numbering observed is 295.

collections.access_check: official home opened once; followup fetch failed; audio links and fiction metadata visible
collections.limitations: Some episodes have several flash stories; full text varies, audio may be needed; repeats and reprints deduplicate by work.

collections.access_check: official page opened; audio and story excerpts; one full-text link points to original magazine
collections.eligible_volume_estimate: 100–250 estimated eligible from roughly 960 numbered episodes
collections.limitations: Fantasy is broader than paranormal everyday setup; audio alone is usable after listening, excerpt is not ending proof; repeats deduplicate.

collections.access_check: official season/episode catalog opened; story ending text not checked
collections.eligible_volume_estimate: hundreds estimated potential stories; eligible total unknown
collections.limitations: Many stories per episode; paywalled full versions; show notes are attribution not complete synopsis.

collections.access_check: official audio/series page opened; ending not verified
collections.eligible_volume_estimate: 1 completed original-series arc, sequel completion unverified
collections.limitations: Current official page advertises sequel Don't Tell Alice; do not assume sequel is complete or merge novel adaptation.

collections.access_check: official root and /episodes fetch failed
collections.limitations: Discovery lead only; inaccessible in current browser tool; no ending evidence verified.

collections.access_check: attempted Libsyn/root fetch failed
collections.limitations: Discovery lead only; current access failed, no text or endings verified.

collections.access_check: 103-broadcast catalog opened plus full Fourble Board script
collections.limitations: Catalog includes repeat broadcasts; numbering 59/60 discrepancy between script and catalog, deduplicate by title/date.

collections.access_check: script library opened and full Quiet Please script sample
collections.eligible_volume_estimate: 10–40 estimated relevant scripts; not entire library
collections.limitations: Mixed genres; select Lights Out, Suspense and supernatural scripts; overlaps Quiet Please should not double-count.

collections.access_check: table of contents and complete text opened
collections.limitations: Exclude final insect essays and non-narrative sketches; check first-batch classics for duplicates.

collections.collection: D. L. Ashliman Folktexts ghost collections
collections.access_check: large scholarly index and full attributed ghost retellings opened; additional type0366 page opened
collections.eligible_volume_estimate: 50–150 estimated paranormal narratives across thematic pages
collections.limitations: Keep source attribution and version; some fake-ghost tales are nonparanormal, others reveal real ghosts. Do not treat same folktale type as same work.

collections.access_check: official catalog and Tombs preview description accessed; full endings not exposed
collections.narrative_unit: short manga story or completed long work
collections.limitations: Official previews mostly omit endings; paid/library full edition needed; overlapping Japanese/English compilations deduplicate by story.

collections.access_check: official catalog opened; marked Completed; panels/endings not checked
collections.limitations: Chapter count is not plot count; Daily Pass/app/image access can prevent automated ending reading.

collections.collection: EC Tales from the Crypt comics
collections.access_check: issue/story history page opened; no full story ending sample
collections.limitations: Need legitimate reprint/full scan or reliable detailed synopsis; avoid confusing television adaptation.

collections.access_check: detailed segment plot page opened, ending text available
collections.eligible_volume_estimate: 3–5 estimated eligible segments plus possible framing story
collections.limitations: One page's source word limit applies cumulatively across all derived segment summaries; exclude mundane infestation if no paranormal evidence.

collections.access_check: detailed plot page opened
collections.limitations: Interlocking chronology and framing; avoid splitting one payoff into duplicated units; page word budget cumulative.

collections.access_check: four-part film detailed plot page opened
collections.limitations: Distinct adaptation record if collected, link literary source without substituting literary ending; page word budget cumulative.

harvest_note: 134 complete plots and12 no-ending source records in this pass. Map estimates and discovery-agent harvest count remain separate from final library counts.
